label: Bing
description: Default engine, works from CN without a proxy.

errors.status: web_search {status} — try: the search backend returned an error; rephrase the query, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.rateLimit: web_search 429 — try: wait 10s before retrying, or rephrase the query; the search backend is rate-limiting this client
errors.forbidden: web_search 403 — try: the search backend is blocking this client; switch engines in Settings (General page), or wait and retry later.
errors.serverError: web_search {status} — try: open the search URL in a browser; if it loads this is transient and a retry in 30s may help
errors.cannotReach: web_search: Cannot reach the Bing endpoint at {endpoint} — try: check your network or proxy, then retry, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.blocked: web_search: Bing anti-bot page — rate-limited or blocked — try: wait 30s and retry, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.noResults: web_search: 0 results but response doesn't look like a real empty page ({chars} chars, first 120: {preview}) — try: rephrase the query with simpler terms, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
